mimic_constraints.parameter_source: explicit post-export correction applied to MuJoCo CPU and MJWarp arrays; not Newton custom attributes

drive_semantics.wheel: Newton joint_target_qd velocity control; no direct side PI torque feed-forward applied
drive_semantics.effort_source: SolverMuJoCo QFRC_ACTUATOR observable mapped through joint_qd_start

mimic_residual_note: folded residual is a modulo-2pi branch diagnostic; for non-unit guide ratios the raw affine equality residual remains authoritative

solver_diagnostics.line_search_limit_semantics: MuJoCo Warp sets LS_ITERATIONS when its inner line search did not converge within configured ls_iterations; this is not a memory/contact capacity flag. solver_niter and equality efc.pos residual are recorded separately.
